title: How Do I: Create a Business Central Trial From Scratch
summary: Creating a Business Central trial requires starting with a clean Microsoft 365 trial tenant using a supported country, then signing up for Business Central at trials.dynamics.com. The trial period begins only when you create a non-demo company, lasting 30 days with options to extend it twice more.
key_points: Start with a new Microsoft 365 trial in an InPrivate browser to ensure a clean environment and predictable trial creation
Select a country where Microsoft provides localization support, as Business Central is not available everywhere and feature availability varies by region
Trial timer activates only when creating a new company beyond the default Cronus demo company, allowing unlimited exploration of demo data first
Trial environments unused for 45 days are automatically removed; keep access to Cronus to prevent deletion
Disable Microsoft 365 recurring billing after setup to avoid unexpected charges when the trial period ends

quotes.text: The moment you create a new company that is not a Cronus demo company, the Business Central trial starts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Understanding when the trial actually begins helps users maximize exploration time with demo data before committing to actual company setup

quotes.text: If a Business Central trial environment is created but no one signs in at all for 45 days, Microsoft may automatically remove the environment.
quotes.why_it_matters: Users need to know about automatic cleanup policies to prevent losing their trial environments

quotes.text: Selecting the correct country during the Microsoft 365 trial setup is important. Business Central is not available in every country.
quotes.why_it_matters: Country selection directly impacts trial creation success and feature availability, making it a critical first decision
